Permissions fixture

foob denies every permission a page asks for (F-78). Click each button and compare with the expected result. The dark panel at the bottom is this page's own log. Pointer lock and notifications need a real click: WebKit refuses them without one.


  1. Expected: the pointer stays free; the log says pointer lock refused. Without the fix (the M1 binary) the pointer disappears and the log says pointer locked; press Escape to release it.

  2. Expected: the log says notifications: denied.
